title: Effects of Ang(1-7) on RDEB mouse model
projectDescription: Analysis of protein abundance changes in mouse paws comparing WT mice to RDEB- and RDEB-Ang(1-7)-treated mice
sampleProcessingProtocol: Skin specimens or whole forepaws were obtained from three age-matched RDEB mice and three wild-type mice per time point. After sacrifice, the back skin was shaved and skin and paws snap-frozen. Tissue was homogenized as for western blot analyses and tissue homogenate boiled under harsh vortexing for 20 min in SDS–PAGE loading buffer with 1 mM DTT. Proteins were separated by 4–12% gradient SDS–PAGE. The gel lanes were cut into 10 equal slices. Proteins were in-gel digested with trypsin and the resulting peptide mixtures were processed on STAGE tips and analyzed by LC-MS/MS.
dataProcessingProtocol: Identification of proteins and protein abundance assignment was performed with MaxQuant software version 1.4.1.2.
